enum: Installing Kata Containers restarts the container runtime on every target node (containerd, or the k3s / RKE2 service that runs it). Running pods keep running; on a single-node k3s or RKE2 cluster the Kubernetes API is unavailable for about 10–20 seconds.

Firecracker (fc) also sets up containerd's devmapper snapshotter on those nodes: a thin-pool on sparse files under /var/lib/runr/devmapper (disk is used only as images and containers fill it) and a systemd unit that activates it at boot. It is loaded by the same container runtime restart.
